description: Source file implementing the DrmFactory class for ClearKey DRM plugin, including creation of DRM and crypto plugins, supported schemes, and dump functionality.

classes.name: DrmFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating DRM and crypto plugins, retrieving supported schemes, and dumping session info.

methods.name: createDrmPlugin
methods.description: Creates a DRM plugin if the UUID is recognized as ClearKey.

methods.name: createCryptoPlugin
methods.description: Creates a crypto plugin if the UUID is recognized as ClearKey.

methods.name: getSupportedCryptoSchemes
methods.description: Returns supported crypto schemes and MIME types.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs current session information to a file descriptor.
